body:
Follow-up to `research/deadband-twin` (merged in #194, which covers the noise-free stall d/K and compensation residuals). This adds measurement noise and dither: the real deadband loop's rms is 27x the linear twin's at s=0.01 but 0.37x at s=0.05, dither only helps without noise, and mild under-compensation beats the exact width under noise. Tests (5), experiment script/results, white paper, README bullet and site entry; `python site/build.py` prints ok. Stylised: scalar integrator, single-seed simulations without confidence intervals.
